directory_policies.notes.4: English policy: TOEFL should be within two years when scores reach EngineeringCAS. The cited below-100 competitiveness comment is not a verified hard cutoff; complete university admission thresholds and alternatives remain under review.
directory_policies.notes.5: Degree background: Recognized three-year-degree equivalency depends on country and credential review. Non-CS preparation may come from coursework or experience; a second related master needs justification.

source_excerpt: The GRE is optional for all applicants.
fact_summary: The FAQ preserves receipt-time TOEFL validity, qualitative competitiveness and credential alternatives without manufacturing a universal threshold.
